description: The pie chart visually represents the time cost distribution before the implementation of efficient deployment methods in the Paper Copilot system, showing two distinct components: “Reduction,” which accounts for 60.9 seconds (69.92% of the total), and “Efficient deployment,” which accounts for 26.2 seconds (30.08%). The chart uses an orange segment for “Reduction” and a blue segment for “Efficient deployment,” with the blue segment slightly exploded outward for emphasis. The total time cost before optimization is noted as 87.1 seconds, and the caption clarifies that the “Reduction” portion reflects the time saved — a 69.92% decrease — after applying efficient deployment techniques. The percentages are displayed within each slice, and the chart serves to highlight how the majority of the original time cost is eliminated through optimization.
